name.en: Pitched roof, rails on L-feet fixed to rafters (mini-rail and rail)
name.es: Cubierta inclinada, rieles sobre escuadras en L fijadas a cabios (mini-riel y riel)

description.en: Rails or mini-rails carried by L-feet, each fixed to a rafter with a lag screw through the roof covering. Torques and pilot hole from IronRidge flush mount manual. Rail profile dimensions, lag size and material grades not found.
description.es: Rieles o mini-rieles sostenidos por escuadras en L, cada una fijada a un cabio con tornillo de madera a través de la cobertura. Pares de apriete y taladro guía del manual IronRidge. Dimensiones del perfil, diámetro del tornillo y grados de material no encontrados.

typical_use: Pitched tile or shingle roofs with timber rafters. Rafter fixing capacity and lag embedment are the designer's responsibility.

materials.material: Aluminium (alloy not stated in IronRidge manual)

geometry.description: Rafter spacing, L-foot spacing and rail spacing not stated in the IronRidge manual. No elements placed.
geometry.coordinate_system: x along module row, y up-slope/north-south horizontal, z up; origin at ground/roof contact of first support; mm and degrees

reference_layout.note: Mini-rail profile: see roof_accessory_catalogue (k2_minirail_60, K2 MiniRail 60 Set). Profile cross-section not found.

accessories.name: Lag screw into rafter (pilot hole 1/4 in)

quantity.note: Count not stated in sources. 0 means unknown, not zero.

accessories.note: Pilot hole 1/4 in (6.35 mm) (manual p. 8). Lag diameter, length and embedment not stated. Lag bolt must be fully seated.

accessories.name: L-foot base hardware (FlashFoot2, All Tile Hook, Knockout Tile, Flush Standoff)

quantity.note: Count not stated in sources. 0 means unknown, not zero.

accessories.note: 132 in-lb (11 ft-lb) converted to 14.9 Nm (manual pp. 8 to 9).

quantity.note: Count not stated in sources. 0 means unknown, not zero.

accessories.purpose: L-foot hardware used on flat-roof attachment
accessories.note: 250 in-lb (21 ft-lb) converted to 28.2 Nm (manual p. 9).

quantity.note: Count not stated in sources. 0 means unknown, not zero.

accessories.name: Rail bonded splice (splice bar with two screws)

quantity.note: Count not stated in sources. 0 means unknown, not zero.

accessories.note: Two screws per rail, about 1 in (25.4 mm) apart; splice inserted 6 in (152.4 mm) into first rail; 20 in-lb converted to 2.3 Nm (manual pp. 3, 4).

quantity.note: Count not stated in sources. 0 means unknown, not zero.

accessories.purpose: Expansion joint between rails with grounding strap
accessories.note: 80 in-lb converted to 9.0 Nm; grounding strap 3/8 in (9.5 mm) from rail end (manual pp. 3, 7). Quantity not stated.

quantity.note: Count not stated in sources. 0 means unknown, not zero.

accessories.note: 80 in-lb converted to 9.0 Nm (manual pp. 3, 5). Clamp height range not stated; compatible frames 30 to 50 mm across makes (pp. 11 to 13).

quantity.note: Count not stated in sources. 0 means unknown, not zero.

accessories.note: 80 in-lb converted to 9.0 Nm (manual pp. 3, 5). Clamp height range not stated.

accessories.note: 80 in-lb converted to 9.0 Nm (text). Diagram on p. 5 labels 84 in-lb; the text value is used.

accessories.name: Grounding lug terminal screw

quantity.note: Count not stated in sources. 0 means unknown, not zero.

quantity.note: Count not stated in sources. 0 means unknown, not zero.

accessories.purpose: Earthing conductor from lugs to earth
accessories.note: Minimum 10 AWG solid or stranded copper (manual p. 5). Length not stated.

accessories.name: Grounding of L-foot and lag bolt (other than lug)

quantity.note: Count not stated in sources. 0 means unknown, not zero.

accessories.purpose: Bonding of lag or L-foot where no lug is used
accessories.note: Not found in IronRidge manual reviewed.

grounding_bonding: Grounding lug with hex nut 80 in-lb (9.0 Nm) and terminal screw 20 in-lb (2.3 Nm); copper conductor minimum 10 AWG (IronRidge manual). Bonded splice and expansion joint values listed below.
installation_notes: Lag bolts must be fully seated (IronRidge manual). Pilot hole 1/4 in (6.35 mm) for FlashFoot2, All Tile Hook and Knockout Tile.
unverified_items: Lag screw diameter and length (not stated in IronRidge manual).
Lag embedment depth into rafter (not stated).
Rail and L-foot material, alloy and finish (not stated).
Rail cross-section dimensions (not stated; K2 MiniRail 60 Set cross-section not found).
Stainless grade or property class for L-foot hardware (not stated).
Rafter spacing, L-foot spacing and rail spacing (not stated).
Quantities per support, per module and per rail (not stated; 0 means unknown).
Torque values are in-lb in the manual; Nm values are converted (x 0.11298). The grounding lug torque is 80 in-lb in the text and 84 in-lb in a diagram; 80 in-lb used.
Module frame height compatibility: 30 to 50 mm across listed makes (pp. 11 to 13); clamp own range not stated.
Microinverter kit nut torque and other IronRidge product lines (not included).
